notes.title: Regions of Ruin: Runegate - A Natural Evolution
notes.content:
Hey mighty dwarves, Steve from Gameclaw here!

I’m one of two core devs working on our upcoming title, Regions of Ruin: Runegate, and I thought it might be nice to share some insight into our upcoming game with you all fresh off of the back of so many of you checking out our show floor demo at Gamescom (thank you to everyone who came along - we truly appreciate you!)

So - what makes Regions of Ruin: Runegate different to the original?

We believe Runegate is everything you loved about Regions of Ruin—but better! We’ve worked hard to refine what made the first game special while polishing every aspect for the sequel. From upgraded visuals and a higher resolution, to a brand new storyline that dives deeper into the lore of the RoR universe, Runegate definitely expands Regions in every aspect. You’ll get to see a variety of unique, visually rich locations as you journey through the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38702002/787671677a5dcf8d8a53813b1c45e55b56809242.png[/img]


Truth be told, I’ve wanted to make a follow-up for years, but I knew that I didn’t want to rush it. The first game really resonated with so many of you, and ever since its release, everyone has been asking for more. I held off until I knew we could deliver something better—something more than “the same game with a different story.” Runegate is less of a “simple sequel” and more of a re-creation, and I think we’ve achieved that in spades.

Most people who loved RoR felt that they didn't have enough to do. We’re working hard to change this experience for players in Runegate, as we feel this is a vital component in elevating RoR and bringing the community together as well. We think we’ve delivered on that front, and we hope you’ll feel the same too when you get your hands on the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38702002/644b4ac235fd5e6a51bd3a9b6763e6b5fa692f10.png[/img]

We’re so excited to give you more news about Regions of Ruin: Runegate when we can, so stay tuned for more updates and if you want to, you can join the mighty dwarves in our [url=https://discord.gg/jHvcavEqpc]Discord[/url] server too for more direct chatter with us or you can follow our [url=https://x.com/Gameclaw_Studio]X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/regionsofruin.bsky.social]BSky[/url] & [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@regionsofruin?lang=en]TikTok[/url] accounts too.

However you keep up with your gaming news, we can’t wait to share more with you, so thanks for taking the time to check in!

Yours dwarvingly,
Steve from Gameclaw

notes.title: Pick up your Weapons for the Sword Celebration!
notes.content:
Mighty Dwarves!

We’re thrilled to feature as part of Steam’s Sword Celebration from now until 7 September. You wouldn’t be a very mighty dwarf without a mighty weapon, and Regions of Ruin: Runegate features a host of shiny steel for you to choose from.

Whether you prefer a longsword, sword & shield, or even something spikier like a mace, you’ll find a weapon to suit your playstyle in our upcoming 2D Hack & Slash Adventure game!

If you’re interested in keeping up with news & getting more information about Runegate, feel free to hop in our Gameclaw [url=https://discord.gg/jHvcavEqpc]Discord[/url], or follow our accounts on [url=https://x.com/Gameclaw_Studio]X[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@regionsofruin?lang=en]TikTok[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/regionsofruin.bsky.social]BSky[/url] if you like too.

notes.title: The Gates of Runegate Are Calling For You: Regions of Ruin Major Announcement
notes.content:
[i]Oh mighty dwarfs, 

We’re calling you for this assembly to request your skills and wisdom as required for the grand rebirth of the magnificent dwarven civilization. Join your brave brethren on this glorious quest full of thrill and adventure, with the noble goal of bringing your ancestor’s lands back to their prosperity. [/i]

[h2]⚔️Announcing Regions of Ruin: Runegate⚔️ [/h2]

In collaboration with Raw Fury, we’re proud to officially announce Regions of Ruin: Runegate - an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure where you attempt to re-establish a haven for the lost dwarven civilization. All that remains of the once-glorious people is dust, scattered exiles, and monster-infested landscapes. Journey across varied lands, help those in need, gather resources and fight off goblins and monsters as you slowly rebuild a home for your fellow dwarfs.  

[previewyoutube=r7q3I3rdwAE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Check out the Steam page for more info on gameplay, mechanics and the feel of the game ⚒️  [/h3]
